title: P3-07 — OpenUI Button action dispatch, verified in a real browser

environment.profile: p3web — isolated DSH_HOME at tmp/dsh-p3 on :3093; production desktop (:61582) untouched
environment.browser: Chromium Agent Window (browser-skill over CDP), session edhi

bundleCheckPerAgentsRule9.outcome: MISMATCH — the profile still held the P3-06 bundle. Copied the fresh build in, re-checked, then MATCH before any measurement.
bundleCheckPerAgentsRule9.note: This is the first run in which the new AGENTS.md §9 rule did real work: it caught the stale bundle before a single browser assertion was made.

checks.name: @Set($count, 6) updates the target and its neighbours
checks.detail: Clicking the set6 Button changed the card from 'count 3 step 1' to 'count 6 step 1': the Slider and the Text both followed, and `step` was untouched.

checks.name: repeated clicks recompute from the latest state
checks.detail: Repeating `combo` twice in a row left 'count 2 step 5' — each click applies the descriptor held by the tree as rendered, so a second identical click is idempotent, not cumulative. The monotone case (a counter built from the current value) is covered by the unit test 'keeps the latest state across repeated clicks'.

checks.name: @Reset() restores every declared default
checks.detail: After `set6` the card read 'count 6'; clicking reset returned it to 'count 3 step 1'.

checks.name: Action([...]) runs its steps in order
checks.detail: `Action([@Set($count, 2), @Set($step, 5)])` produced 'count 2 step 5' — both writes applied, in one re-evaluation.

checks.name: a Button's write survives a reload
checks.detail: The card was left at 'count 6 step 5'; after a full page reload both copies read 'count 6 step 5'.

checks.name: both display surfaces agree after a Button change
checks.detail: After the reload the toolview copy (inside the fold) and the turn-tail copy (outside it) both read 'count 6 step 5'. Before the reload the stale copy still showed 'count 3'; the remount read the shared key and they converged.

checks.name: no new console errors or React warnings
checks.detail: Clicked every Button on a freshly loaded page (set6, reset, combo, set6) and then read the console buffer: 0 entries, 0 errors, 0 warnings.

checks.name: switching sessions shows no other session's cards or state (backfilled)
checks.detail: A new session showed 0 cards, while both stored records stayed under their own session keys. Returning to the original session restored 'count 6 step 5'.

checks.name: history replay across card generations (backfilled)
checks.detail: Three generations of card replayed on the tail with their own values: the pre-P3-06 card at 8, the P306 card at 3, and the P307 actions card at 6. The HTML control card also kept its tail copy.

checks.name: an invalid variable binding writes nothing and reports a diagnostic
checks.detail: Not reachable from a program: the evaluator only produces a binding descriptor for a legal `$variable`, so a bad binding cannot be expressed in openui-lang. Covered by unit tests against hand-built descriptors (action.bad-binding, action.unknown-variable).

checks.name: unsupported actions produce no external side effect
checks.detail: Unit-tested (action.unsupported for @OpenUrl/@CopyToClipboard/@ToAssistant; an actionless Button writes nothing and posts nothing). Not driven in the browser, because the browser check would have to prove a negative — no navigation, no clipboard write — through side effects the harness cannot observe.

checks.name: HTML regression
checks.detail: No HTML card was exercised with actions in this browser run; the HTML control card rendered and kept its tail copy, but its frame state was not re-driven. Covered by unit tests: tests/frame-state.spec.tsx 17/17 including the newly added cross-view pinning cases.
